items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: Marshall Royal was pretty good at that too you know. Marshall was very bright and he was a very fine lead alto player... one of the most natural musicians I ever encountered.

ctx.x: That must have been quite an experience for an arranger to work on something and keep hearing this — here’s how it goes in my head — to come in and he’d say, “no, not like that.”

That’s right. And turn it totally into something else. Marshall Royal was pretty good at that too you know. Marshall was very bright and he was a very fine lead alto player, very gruff but he was a genius. Very gruff. A beautiful sound, and it was just one of the most natural musicians I ever encountered.
They call it “Straw Boss.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
